ModMetaData.name: SillyAnimalThings
ModMetaData.author: Ordoxous
ModMetaData.description:
Gives animals silly abilities, using the same special-training system as Odyssey's war trumpet. Wild and manhunting animals use them on their own; tamed animals use them once trained.
- Elephant: trunk blast (a water spray that knocks enemies back, staggers them and puts out fires) and trunk throw (picks up a nearby rock chunk and launches it) - Boomalope: detonate (charges a target and blows itself up) - Alphabeaver: gnaw (chews through wooden structures and eats them; hungry wild alphabeavers will snack on your buildings) - Boomrat: fire burst (sprays burning fuel around itself, requires Biotech) - Penguin: belly slide (a fast dash along the ground) - Walrus: charge (barrels into a target, battering and knocking back nearby enemies) - Wolverine: regenerate (a burst of rapid healing, used automatically when badly hurt) - Tiger: hidden dragon (turns invisible until it strikes, used automatically before pouncing)
